csv_project_name: Design for BUS 51 Kent Street Reconstruction
csv_agency: State of Wisconsin Dept of Trans Div Of Hwys
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Wisconsin , Department of Transportation , may be seeking a Consultant to provide Design for Modernization project to reconstruct approximately 2.43 miles of BUS 51from Kent St. to E Thomas St. in the City of Wausau in Marathon County. Design a reconstruction of the roadway including removing the center islands, installing monotubes for lighting, adjusting signals, and removing and replacing structure approaches. Replacement of curb and gutter is anticipated. Railroad, utility, and real estate coordination is also anticipated.
